jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.location: Northern America, Europe, UK, France, European timezones
jobs.jd_full:
## About Outsite

 

Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.

 

## About Outsite for Teams

 

Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

 

## Role Overview

 

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.

 

This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

 

## Key Responsibilities

 

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound

- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder

- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base

- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging

- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages

- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities

 

### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management

- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture

- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close

- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged

- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets

 

### 3. Collaboration & Handoff

- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound

- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals

- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time

 

### 4. Reporting

- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers

- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

 

## Required Skills & Experience

 

- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)

- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders

- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads

- Able to work autonomously and independently 

- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive 

- Comfortable working European timezone hours

- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job

- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to

- Comfortable using AI in workflow

 

## Nice to Have

 

- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams

- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot

- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space

- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product

 

## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

 

- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)

- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM

- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed

- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing

- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

 

## Benefits

 

- Remote, travel encouraged

- Credits for Outsite locations 

- Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner - Core Services
jobs.jd_full:
Location
Our Technical Product Owner - DoiT Cloud Intelligence - Core Services will be an integral part of our global Product team. This role is based remotely in the East Coast US, the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityWe’re hiring a Technical Product Owner to drive rapid delivery and iteration for the Core Services team of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, our platform that helps DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and FinOps teams manage public cloud environments effectively and efficiently. Core Services builds and operates foundational platform capabilities used across DoiT’s products and engineering teams. Its responsibilities include identity and access management, authentication and authorization, customer and tenant services, shared APIs, platform integrations, and other cross-cutting capabilities. This role is designed for someone with a technical product mindset who is comfortable working deep within platform architecture, distributed systems, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and internal engineering workflows. You will help turn broad platform needs into clear technical product direction, sequenced investments, and reliably delivered capabilities. You will report to a VP of Product and work as an embedded member of the Core Services Engineering team. You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership, architects, security, product teams, and internal platform consumers to determine what the team should build next and why.

Role clarity: VP of Product vs. Technical Product Owner

VP of Product (what they own)

  • Sets the overall vision, strategy, positioning, and long-range roadmap for the platform area.
  • Makes the highest-level prioritization calls across multiple components and investment themes.
  • Aligns stakeholders across the company (executive leadership, GTM, partners) on direction and tradeoffs.
  • Defines success at the portfolio/area level and ensures the area’s outcomes ladder up to company goals.

Technical Product Owner (what you own)

  • Owns delivery, iteration, and learning velocity for the Core Services.
  • Turns VP-level direction into clear problems to solve, a prioritized backlog, and incrementally shippable scope.
  • Runs the feedback loop: discover → define → build → release → measure → iterate, repeatedly.
  • Works within the Engineering teams to ensure they are always building the highest-value next increment with clarity, quality
  • Review technical designs, reason about tradeoffs and constraints, and understand their impact on delivery timelines and system behavior, without being the primary implementer
  • Leverages deep, hands-on DevOps experience and public cloud understanding to ensure that solution implementations are done correctly

This distinction matters: the VP creates the “why” and “where”; the Product Owner ensures the “what next” is always sharp, validated, and shipping.

Responsibilities

Fast iteration and backlog leadership

  • Translate the VP’s strategy into a sequenced backlog of problems, user stories, and acceptance criteria that the Engineering team can deliver continuously.
  • Keep work “thin-sliced” so the team can ship frequently, learn quickly, and reduce risk through iteration.
  • Maintain a disciplined cadence of backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and scope negotiation to keep delivery predictable without slowing innovation.

Deep user and workflow understanding

  • Leverage your hands-on DevOps experience and expertise in the real-world workflows of the professionals you’re building for - especially cloud operators and practitioners.
  • Use firsthand domain knowledge and ongoing customer conversations to identify friction, gaps, and opportunities for differentiation.
  • Prioritize enhancements that materially improve outcomes: speed, reliability, clarity, safety, governance, cost impact, or operational simplicity.

Customer validation and external communication

  • Often speak with customers (aiming for 3-5 calls a week) and cross-functional DoiT stakeholders regularly to test ideas, validate assumptions, and pressure-test tradeoffs.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently: share concepts early, take feedback openly, synthesize input into decisions, and explain “why” in a way that builds trust.
  • Rely on your hands-on, DevOps experience to go deep with stakeholders (internal/external) into the technical details of the problem, our solution, and the contexts and environments in which both of these exist.
  • Support beta/design-partner motions where appropriate by shaping hypotheses, success criteria, and rollout plans.

Engineering-embedded technical product ownership

  • Operate as a core member of the Core Services’ Engineering team - present in daily collaboration, crisp in decision-making, and pragmatic about constraints.
  • Partner with Engineering leads on sequencing, technical tradeoffs, and delivery planning - ensuring product intent survives implementation realities.
  • Ensure Core Services are cohesive across UX, APIs, data, and operational behavior - and that it meets a high bar for reliability and customer trust.

Quality, outcomes, and measurement

  • Define what “success” means for Core Services with clear metrics (adoption, activation, workflow completion, time-to-value, retention, reliability signals, customer-reported impact).
  • Instrument learning: make sure releases are measurable and that insights reliably flow back into prioritization.
  • Own release readiness for Core Services: documentation, enablement inputs, and clear communication of what’s new and why it matters.

Safety, governance, and trust by design

  • Ensure product requirements account for real-world cloud environments: IAM boundaries, auditability, guardrails, and safe defaults.
  • Partner with security, support, and customer teams to anticipate edge cases and ensure Core Services earns trust over time.

Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of hands-on experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, SRE, Cloud Engineer, Solutions Architect, or a similar roles working with or building products for public cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure).
  • A strong product sense for turning messy problems into clear scope and shipped value - without waiting for perfect information.
  • Systems thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, architectural tradeoffs, and long-term platform evolution.
  • Prioritization: Demonstrated ability to balance customer needs, engineering constraints, and platform investments when making prioritization decisions.
  • Deep curiosity and technical fluency in cloud fundamentals (cost/billing concepts, identity/IAM, networking, compute, Kubernetes, observability, automation), and experience building solutions that leverage or focus on these technologies
  • Coding experience is a plus - enough to collaborate effectively with engineers, reason about feasibility, and understand system behaviors.
  • Excellent communication skills: you can explain complex ideas simply, facilitate alignment, and confidently engage with customers and experts.
  • A bias for action and continuous improvement: you ship, measure, learn, and iterate - building capabilities that become a meaningful competitive differentiator.

How success will be measured

  • The Core Services’ roadmap advances through frequent, high-quality releases with clear customer value.
  • Customer feedback loops are strong: you can show how insights translated into shipped improvements.
  • Adoption and outcomes improve measurably (usage, engagement, workflow completion, reliability, and customer impact).
  • The Engineering team consistently has clarity on the next most valuable increment to build - and why.

Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do’ers, One TeamDoiT unites as Many Do’ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal—it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Limble

At Limble we empower the unsung heroes who support the world. We’re revolutionizing the way businesses manage their maintenance operations by providing a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to optimize asset performance and drive operational excellence. From preventive maintenance to inventory management and beyond, our robust CMMS platform offers a suite of features designed to streamline operations and enhance productivity.

About the Role

AI is a growing part of how we build our product and how our team works. We’re exploring how AI and machine learning can help maintenance teams predict equipment failures before they happen, catch problems earlier, and prevent costly downtime, and more. Within your product area, you’ll help shape where AI creates the most value for our customers, while also using it to move faster in your own day-to-day. You’ll report to a Group Product Manager, most likely on our Inventory Management product, though your specific product area may shift based on business needs.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Partnering with engineering, design, and other product managers throughout the full product lifecycle, from discovery to launch, to ship features that solve real customer problems

  • Gathering, organizing, and prioritizing feature requests and requirements from customers, sales, design, and other stakeholders

  • Writing clear product requirements and driving timely cross-functional execution

  • Identifying and scoping opportunities to use AI and machine learning, like predicting equipment failures before they happen, to help maintenance teams work smarter and avoid costly downtime

  • Using AI tools to accelerate your own workflow, including research, requirements writing, and data analysis

  • Participating in quality assurance testing before feature deployment

  • Documenting features and workflows to grow our internal knowledge base

Requirements

  • A desire to work in the B2B / SaaS market; experience in CMMS is a plus

  • 2-5 years of experience in product management or a related field

  • Experience working in an Agile development environment and product management tools (e.g., Productboard, JIRA), including building roadmaps and communicating updates to stakeholders

  • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment and collaborating with teammates across multiple time zones

  • Demonstrated involvement across the entire product lifecycle, from ideation to launch to research and innovation

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to derive insights from data sets, analyze product usage and adoption trends (e.g., using tools like Pendo), and understand client needs

  • Exceptional writing and interpersonal skills, paired with strong independent time management

  • A problem-solver who’s comfortable with ambiguity and has a bias toward action; you get to the root cause and creatively solve challenges quickly

  • Highly collaborative, data-driven, and open to giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback

  • Demonstrates fluency with AI tools and workflows, applying them pragmatically to accelerate work while exercising sound judgment about when and how to use them.

  • Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) day-to-day to work faster and smarter

  • Experience contributing to or shipping AI/ML-powered features (e.g., predictive analytics, anomaly detection) is a strong plus

Benefits

  • Salary Range: $130,000- $150,000

  • Fully remote position

  • Flexible PTO

  • 13 paid company holidays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance

  • Employer paid Basic Life insurance and Short-Term Disability insurance

  • Company contribution match for HSA and 401(k)

  • Flexible Spending Accounts

  • Monthly employee wellness stipend

  • Opportunities for Learning and Development Reimbursement

  • Pet insurance

Limble is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetics, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable laws. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with applicable laws.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About the Role

Conversica is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of our AI-powered products. This role sits at the intersection of customers, engineering, sales, and customer success, translating customer and market needs into clear product direction and solutions that create measurable business impact.

Working closely with the Chief Product Officer, you will lead product discovery, help define new product capabilities, partner with Engineering throughout the development lifecycle, and support the successful introduction of new products and features to the market.

This is an opportunity to influence the future direction of Conversica’s product portfolio and contribute across the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and product definition through launch and adoption.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Discovery

  • Conduct customer discovery interviews and market research to identify customer needs, pain points, and market opportunities.

  • Help shape product strategy and priorities in alignment with company objectives.

  • Translate customer and market insights into clear product requirements, functional specifications, and user stories.

  • Prioritize product initiatives based on customer value, business impact, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.

  • Bring customer insights and market perspectives into roadmap and product-planning discussions.

Product Development

  • Partner closely with Engineering throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Provide clear context, requirements, and success criteria for new product capabilities.

  • Work through product questions and tradeoffs with technical and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.

  • Support roadmap planning, feature prioritization, and product decision-making.

Go-to-Market and Product Marketing

  • Develop clear product positioning, messaging, and value propositions.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to plan and execute product launches.

  • Create sales enablement materials, competitive insights, and internal product education.

  • Ensure customer-facing teams understand new product capabilities, their intended value, and how to position them effectively.

  • Contribute product content and product demonstrations to support launches and customer education.

  • Gather feedback following launches to inform adoption efforts and future product improvements.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a strong voice of the customer across the organization.

  • Build trusted relationships with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and executive leadership.

  • Influence product decisions through customer feedback, market knowledge, business context, and data.

  • Communicate product direction and decisions clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Success in This Role

Within your first 6 to 12 months, you will:

  • Establish a consistent approach to customer discovery and synthesizing customer insights.

  • Become a trusted partner to Engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Strengthen product requirements, product definition, and decision-making practices.

  • Help prioritize the roadmap based on customer needs, company strategy, and business impact.

  • Improve cross-functional readiness and alignment for new product launches.

  • Bring meaningful customer and market insights into strategic product discussions.

  • Help drive stronger understanding, adoption, and feedback for newly launched capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Experience owning products or major product initiatives from customer discovery through launch.

  • Strong experience partnering closely with Engineering teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to gather customer insights and translate them into clear product requirements and decisions.

  • Experience writing product requirements, functional specifications, user stories, or similar product documentation.

  • Experience contributing to product positioning, launches, or other outbound product activities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and product leadership.

  • Ability to operate independently and effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in automotive technology, dealer technology, or automotive SaaS.

  • Experience with AI, conversational AI, or data-driven software products.

  • Product marketing or go-to-market experience.

  • Sales enablement or customer-facing product experience.

  • A technical, solutions consulting, or solution architecture background.

  • Experience building or launching enterprise SaaS products.

Why Join Conversica?

You will have the opportunity to help define new AI-powered product capabilities, work closely with executive and technical leadership, and solve complex customer problems with meaningful business impact. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys combining customer discovery, strategic product thinking, hands-on execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

Compensation and Benefits

This is a full-time, exempt position. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $145,000 to $185,000 annually, depending on experience, skills, qualifications, and other relevant factors.

This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus targeted at 10% of base salary, as well as equity participation.

Conversica offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible paid time off, paid company holidays, and a 401(k) plan.

jobs.title: TPM, Fixed
jobs.jd_full:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About the Role

Dandy is hiring a Technical Program Manager to join our rapidly expanding Automation Team. Dandy’s Automation Team is responsible for leading the design and implementation our factories’ automation and mechanized equipment. This highly visible role will be instrumental in innovating, developing, and deploying automated systems to achieve ambitious and industry leading quality standards in the dental industry.

What You’ll Do

  • You will take the lead in driving the technical, operational, and deployment of various manufacturing automation initiatives within the organization.

  • Innovate factory processes, concepts, and design to enable an ideal automated manufacturing process.

  • Work closely with factory teams to create and achieve OKRs for automation and continuous improvement programs.

  • Work with our factory team to draft requirements documents, develop concepts, and envision the automated manufacturing process.

  • Create Request for Quotation/Proposal (RFQ/RFPs) that documents the design requirements of the automated equipment, delivery schedule, required documentation and qualification for acceptance at machine supplier facility and our factory.

  • Engage with vendors to construct the machines, ensuring the system aligns with Dandy’s specifications and standards.

  • Ensure vendors are conforming to Dandy’s ARS specs and requirements.

  • Approve vendor process, process flow and automation equipment design.

  • Design and execute FAT, SAT (acceptance testing) and commissioning of automation equipment/line into our factories.

  • Lead the initiative in integrating the newly built machines into the factory, working alongside engineers and manufacturing teams to ensure optimal operation.

  • Supervise and report OEE, Yield, manufacturing metrics (CpK, FMEA etc.) from automated systems. Interpret machine output metrics to drive improvement programs as appropriate.

  • Routine status reporting to executives and escalation of issues as needed.

  • Set aggressive targets and drive plans to achieve success.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in Advanced Manufacturing and high speed custom automation: Automation Engineering, Process Engineering, and Technical Program Management and translating NPI requirements to large scale custom automation solutions.

  • Strong background in prioritizing tasks for AME’s and Suppliers from Conceptual Design through SAT and Production Team Training.

  • Experience in managing high budget projects and tracking spend with external vendors. Previous display of Value Engineering, contract engagement, managing NRE, and RFQ to PO issuance process.

  • Strong technical skills, involving problem solving and issue root causing in a high pressure environment.

  • Ability to run automation program with minimum supervision.

  • Interpersonal skills of leadership, project management, communication, collaboration, influencing and negotiation.

  • In-depth understanding of Process, assembly automation pertaining to equipment validation through FAT/SAT (optical inspection, GRR, OEE, Line Balancing and Process Flow optimization).

  • Capability to summarize and articulate technical updates into executive-leve. presentations (know your audience and tailor the presentation accordingly).

  • Constant partnership with cross-functional teams across Dandy, its equipment suppliers, and technical consultants.

  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 30%.

  • BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering or allied technical subject.

Bonus Points For

  • Strong professional references showcasing successful past projects.

  • Experience with ceramics, CNC machining, spray applications, inkjet printing, etc.

  • Experience with plastics, 3D printing, thermoforming, injection molding, etc.

  • Experience with technical writing of specifications specific to machine user requirements.

  • Experience with Contract engagement and negotiation of CapEx.

  • Experience in FDA regulated manufacturing environment (ISO 13485, Change Control, IQ, OQ, PQ Equipment Validation..etc).

  • Relentlessly positive attitude and the ability to have fun at work.

  • High growth startup scaling experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Scholar Outreach, Career & Graduate School Opportunities
jobs.jd_full:

The right candidate for the role is passionate about ensuring that outreach processes, communications, and events are delivered with care and consistency to positively impact the lives of current college students and early to mid-career professionals.

This role provides an exciting opportunity to participate in new initiatives and areas of growth for the organization. Reporting to the Director of Scholar Outreach, Career and Graduate Opportunities, and working closely with our partnerships, data, and communication teams, they will play a key role in the implementation of our career and graduate school opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide support to QuestBridge Scholars and Alumni throughout application processes while managing vendor relationships and bolstering overall team operational efficiency.
  • Develop and deliver dynamic, high impact recruitment events and program resources to support applicants through various opportunities.
  • Become an expert in the team’s project management tools, and adept at creating efficient, streamlined systems to optimize workflows.
  • Use tracking, surveys, and analytics to measure the impact of our outreach efforts.
  • Work with the team to gain a deep understanding of the population we serve and the opportunities we offer.
  • Research and stay informed in hiring practices, employment trends and other labor related issues, and news and trends in the graduate school admissions and financial aid space.

  • Familiarity and passion for selective graduate school admissions, career services, life design, or campus recruitment.
  • Ability to manage multiple programs while maintaining a high level of organization and professionalism.
  • Track record of setting priorities, establishing operational processes, and executing on plans with measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including public speaking experience.
  • Able to comfortably adapt in a dynamic, remote working environment with changing requirements and priorities.
  • Heightened sensitivity to students from diverse backgrounds.

Qualities

  • Exceptional attention to detail combined with ability to maintain focus on the big picture.
  • Self-starting, resourceful, and organized with a keen sense of accountability.
  • Warm, positive personality; ability to collaborate well with others. Exceptional interpersonal skills.
  • Strong work ethic and deep-seated personal integrity, with intense drive to reach goals and contribute to the success of the organization.

Compensation and Benefits

We offer competitive compensation commensurate with experience and skills for the position. The range for the position is $62,400 - $78,000.

QuestBridge strives to provide the best possible benefits for our team members. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance including access to flexible spending and health savings accounts; generous Paid Time Off, holidays, and annual end-of-year office closure; 401k (pretax or Roth); paid parental leave; remote work stipends; flexible work hours; and many more.

Hours and Location

This is a full-time, remote position and can be based anywhere in the United States.

About QuestBridge

QuestBridge connects high-achieving students from low-income backgrounds with a thriving community and transformative educational, career, and life opportunities that help propel them to lives of fulfillment, meaning, and purpose. From our founding over 30 years ago, QuestBridge has always been an organization focused on creating opportunities for students from low-income backgrounds, regardless of race, geography, or academic interest.

Application Process

Apply by uploading your resume and cover letter. Due to the large number of applications we receive, we ask that candidates refrain from calling or mailing applications. Thank you for your interest in employment with QuestBridge. QuestBridge is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst, Consumer Analytics (f/m/x)
jobs.jd_full:
S’more about the team

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst, with deep expertise in web and app analytics, to help drive data-informed product and growth decisions across our organization. You will join our analytics and reporting team working globally between our Berlin and New York City offices.

You will solve challenging business problems using digital product usage and customer data, to create the best digital product experiences that delight and retain customers. Your insights will drive user experience design, product development, and customer journey optimization and you will provide professional grade dashboarding and reporting that reaches the C-suite level for some of our most critical product and growth initiatives.

Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for

  • Partner widely across the Senior Product organisation (Product, Software Engineering, UX leads) to set strategic priorities and promote a culture rooted in evidence-based decision making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and define project objectives while utilising project management skills to plan and execute data-driven projects.
  • Design, implement and analyze A/B tests and experiments to measure product feature impact and optimize user experiences.
  • Develop automated reporting and dashboards that democratize data access and enable self-service analytics across the organization.
  • Build sophisticated analytics solutions to define KPI trees, design measurement frameworks, and track product performance across app and web platforms, to identify opportunities for product improvement and growth.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to dramatically increase efficiency in data analysis, reporting, and insight generation workflows.
  • Communicate complex data and statistical concepts persuasively to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influencing strategic decisions.
  • Review as a technical expert the implementations of multiple teams across domains, continuously improving the deliverables of your teams.
  • All other duties, as assigned

Sound a-peeling? Here’s what we’re looking for

  • A BS or equivalent in business, computer science, mathematics, economics, statistics, engineering, or a relevant quantitative field.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) / Snowplow, including advanced configuration, custom event tracking, and experience with Mixpanel/Amplitude.
  • Advanced BigQuery experience required, including complex SQL queries, query optimization, data modeling, and working with large-scale datasets.
  • Advanced Python programming skills for data analysis, automation, and building analytical tools (pandas, numpy, etc.).
  • Strong Excel skills including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data visualization.
  • Demonstrated track record of leveraging AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) to increase personal and team productivity in day-to-day analytical work.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio required.
  • Deep understanding of product analytics methodology like Understanding of Cookie/Event tracking, user behavior analysis, and Event experimentation design etc.
  • Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics required.
  • Experience with dbt, Airflow, or other modern data stack tools preferred.
  • Previous experience in fast-paced product-led or consumer-facing technology companies required.
  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience analyzing complex data in a business context, with at least 3 years focused on product or web/app analytics.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously and drive projects from ambiguous problem statements to actionable recommendations.

Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you’ll love it here

  • Box Discount- Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.
  • Health & Wellness- Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!
  • Vacation & PTO- Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.
  • Family Benefits- A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.
  • Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team
  • Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!
  • Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives- With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.
  • Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

#LI-HYBRID

HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.

This is a posting for an existing vacancy. We are actively seeking to fill this position.
